snippet.title: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Gameplay Trailer for NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii, a 2.5D puzzle platformer developed by Lapsus Games. Players will make use of timeline-based navigation in the Cold War era. Explore a nuclear complex to plan a route for a trusty robot and influence a narrative with choices to solve the mystery. NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#NODE #Gaming #IGN
